object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Start an export from a Document Editor with a stand-in PDF program that doesn't finish until the test releases it. While it runs, keep the window's event loop running and press Export again. Expected: the PDF is produced off the window's event loop, so the window keeps handling events during the export; Export is disabled and a second press reports that an export is already running; after the release the PDF is written and Export is enabled again.
